title: DIMENSION picture BLOCK body closure fast slice
mode: local implementation and generated focused controls
scope: Extend strict modern DIMENSION group-2 admission from planned BLOCK_RECORD name to an emitted and closed BLOCK body
Allow forward picture references within BLOCKS and verify them at the section boundary
Rollback emitted-body and pending-reference indexes on failure
Preserve standalone writer, empty-name, and R12 behavior

implementation.transactionBehavior: RecordStateScope journals both indexes and restores block phase/name state; DxfWriterRecordScope plus the existing outer writer transaction preserve the output on failure
implementation.forwardReferences: Collected while BLOCKS is active; every pending DIMENSION picture name must resolve to a body closed before writeBlocks commits

generatedCoverage: ordinary DIMENSION, ARC_DIMENSION, and LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION writers
planned name with missing body is refused before later entity bytes
emitted and closed body admits picture target
forward picture reference inside another block resolves when later body is emitted
missing forward target refuses BLOCKS atomically and rolls both indexes back

remaining: nested INSERT target and style/arrow/linetype resource closure
independent parsed override dictionary and native rendering/acceptance
assessment.limitations: The index proves only a planned named BLOCK_RECORD has a corresponding emitted and closed BLOCK/ENDBLK body. It does not prove the correct source child set/owners, nested references, resource resolution, constraint semantics, correct geometry, complete CLI behavior, or consumer rendering.
